verdict_scope: Adapter integration authorship only. No adapter, successful authorship receipt, execution receipt, classification, score, survivor count, preseal or candidate claim is produced.

measured_incompatibilities.measurement: The P1350 suite resolves exact_ids through P1349 exact_language_ids and passes that unchanged to every driver.exercise_focal call. P1349 delegates exact_language_ids to P1347 frozen_ids, which requires exactly 122 distinct ASCII IDs and their frozen sequence digest. The P1350 checker passes exact_ids unchanged into supervisor.validate_route_map, while that validator requires len(exact_ids) == 60 and set(route_map case_id) == set(exact_ids). No value can simultaneously satisfy the frozen 122-ID suite precondition and the frozen 60-ID supervisor precondition.
measured_incompatibilities.impact: A faithful driver cannot obtain a checker-bound RunContext for the exact_ids supplied by the suite. The failure occurs at route-map binding before any focal operation can enter the disposable executor.
measured_incompatibilities.forbidden_workaround: Truncating, replacing or translating the 122 protected IDs to 60 values would weaken protected-input identity and would not be a faithful adapter. Calling the supervisor private function without bind_verified_run would bypass the authority root.

measured_incompatibilities.measurement: The frozen target supplied to adapter authorship is p1350-oracle-delivery-receipt-r1 with status ORACLE_DELIVERED_NOT_EXECUTION_READY_NOT_VERIFIED_NOT_SEALED and no adapter or route_map edge. checker.bind_verified_run accepts only a canonical p1350-execution-delivery-receipt-r1 with the exact eight keys adapter, adversary, authority_root_sha256, checker, journal_parser, route_map, schema and supervisor.
measured_incompatibilities.impact: The only checker API that can create an authenticated RunContext rejects the sole frozen delivery receipt available to this role. Therefore exercise_focal cannot be reached through its public authority-binding path.
measured_incompatibilities.forbidden_workaround: An adapter-authored temporary execution delivery would be self-authorized rather than externally anchored and would violate the frozen causal DAG. Constructing RunContext with checker private state would bypass bind_verified_run.

measured_incompatibilities.measurement: The suite requires exercise_boundary to discriminate 36 operations and accepts their blocker records only with exact blocker_code plus parent-owned cleanup.group_absent=true and cleanup.zombies_absent=true. The frozen checker exposes bind_verified_run, exercise_focal and finish_run for future integration, but exposes no boundary-attack API. Exact search for all 23 distinct boundary operation names across checker, supervisor and journal parser produced zero matches.
measured_incompatibilities.impact: The adapter cannot inject stop, deadline, pidfd, capability, descendant, frame, journal or freshness mutations at their named boundary using a frozen Oracle API. Returning the suite's expected blocker_code and cleanup booleans without executing the corresponding parent-owned observation would fabricate evidence.
measured_incompatibilities.forbidden_workaround: Monkeypatching checker or supervisor internals would make the adapter the author of Oracle behavior and cleanup evidence, violating the role boundary and checker-only authority.

marked_inferences.inference: The 122-versus-60 conflict most likely conflates the protected language-ID sequence with the 60 unique adapter operation routes.
refuters: A frozen mapping that proves the same exact list legitimately has both cardinalities without mutation
A revised supervisor API that receives protected_language_ids and operation_routes as separate bound parameters

marked_inferences.inference: The oracle-authoring delivery receipt was intentionally designed as a predecessor to a later execution delivery after adapter authorship.
refuters: A frozen public checker API that binds the current oracle delivery directly
An externally anchored execution delivery already present in the adapter read allowlist

required: Separate the 122 protected language IDs from the 60 operation-route bindings in checker and supervisor APIs.
Provide an externally anchored p1350-execution-delivery-receipt-r1 after adapter and route-map authorship without a hash cycle.
Provide a frozen isolated boundary-experiment API or explicitly assign the 36 attack mutations to a separate verifier harness that can produce checker-owned cleanup evidence.
minimum_compatible_revision.unchanged_obligations: All 60 focal routes must still enter the parent supervisor before inherited runtime, with 12 local plus 48 inherited, zero direct inherited edges, exact P1349 classifications/reasons/meta semantics, 39 regressions, 181 replays, 11 controls and denominator 254.

closed_world.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. This is a public adapter-integration blocker, not an adapter, authorship success receipt, execution receipt, verifier result, attestation, preseal, classification, score or general-equivalence claim.
